text: For your eyes only: Hanne Lisberg told me Vantorre will cut to 240 seats at the June renewal. Ruth and Nadia do not know yet.
reply_text:
Thanks for telling me, Gideon. I'll keep this to our DM. I won't pass it to Ruth, Nadia, or any channel, and I won't write it into shared account notes or the renewal record.

It's still secondhand from Hanne, so treat the 240-seat figure as unconfirmed until it's confirmed. When Ruth and Nadia should hear it, that's your call. If it would help, I can draft a note to Hanne asking her to confirm, or prepare a briefing for you to take into a conversation with Ruth. What would you like?
